# Eastgate Tavern - Table 14 Guest Service Briefing
Shift: Dinner, 05/16/2026 | Server: Hannah Castillo | Floor Lead: Leah Gallagher

## Table Profile and Dietary Restrictions
| Seat | Guest Name | Recorded Dietary Need | Beverage Order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Walter Kowalczyk | Celiac disease (strict gluten-free) | Sparkling water, lime |
| 2 | Claire Kowalczyk | Peanut and tree nut allergy | Iced tea |
| 3 | Brian Mercer | None reported | Draft IPA |
| 4 | Danielle Mercer | Lactose intolerance | Pinot noir |

## Dinner Specials and Kitchen Data
| Item Name | Description | Allergen Profile | Price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pan-Seared Halibut | Sweet corn succotash, bacon lardons, herb oil | Dairy-free, Nut-free, Gluten-free | $36 |
| Wild Mushroom Tagliatelle | House-made egg pasta, truffle cream sauce, parmesan | Contains dairy, gluten, eggs | $28 |
| Grilled Ribeye (12 oz) | Rosemary roasted red potatoes, garlic-parsley butter | Gluten-free (contains dairy in butter) | $44 |
| Eastgate Chopped Salad | Romaine, crisp chickpeas, shaved pecorino, walnut vinaigrette | Contains tree nuts, dairy | $16 |

## Server Presentation and Recommendation Plan
- Greet party warmly, distribute printed menus, and verbally highlight the pan-seared halibut and grilled ribeye specials.
- Recommend the wild mushroom tagliatelle for Walter Kowalczyk as an entree pairing with his sparkling water.
- Advise Claire Kowalczyk that the Eastgate chopped salad dressing can be substituted with house citrus vinaigrette to avoid tree nuts.
- Take beverage reorders before clearing appetizer plates.
- For Danielle Mercer, recommend the grilled ribeye with the kitchen instructed to hold the garlic-parsley butter.
- Provide allergen check verification to kitchen expediter Leah Gallagher prior to firing main courses.

errors.quote: Recommend the wild mushroom tagliatelle for Walter Kowalczyk as an entree pairing
errors.explanation: Walter Kowalczyk has documented celiac disease requiring strict gluten-free dining, but the wild mushroom tagliatelle is made with house egg pasta and is explicitly listed as containing gluten.
errors.fix: Recommend the pan-seared halibut for Walter Kowalczyk as an entree pairing

errors.quote: Advise Claire Kowalczyk that the Eastgate chopped salad dressing can be substituted with house citrus vinaigrette to avoid tree nuts.
errors.explanation: The Eastgate chopped salad contains shaved pecorino cheese in addition to the walnut vinaigrette; substituting the vinaigrette addresses nuts, but the note omits asking or verifying if she wishes to keep or modify the dairy, or omits warning that walnuts are prepared on the station.
errors.fix: Advise Claire Kowalczyk that the Eastgate chopped salad dressing can be substituted with house citrus vinaigrette and prep surfaces wiped to avoid tree nut cross-contact.
